title: Noël 3: Not Digital
overview:
action/circuit/dialog/emotion/empathy/expression/icon/love/motion/smile/voice/...and more

Noel 3 is a hacking adventure. On Christmas Eve, as the students of class 3-B prepare their holiday party, a group posing as an environmental organization seizes their high school and takes the class hostage. One student, Yuka Okano, slips away from the captors, hands you a hacking program and backs you up from her hiding place.

Break into the school's systems from the outside and use what you control to guide the trapped girls to safety. Video phone calls let you check on each student and direct her to a safe spot, while classmates such as Tina Nishimura and Kotomi Wakura face the crisis in their own ways. Who you manage to rescue shapes how the night ends.

- Digital video and voiced conversations
- Three game discs
- Shorter load times with the Extended RAM Cartridge (1MB or 4MB)
- This first-press limited edition adds a bonus audio disc
